description.name: Entry
description.text: Ten single hybrid attacks (0.71 or 1.80 each), grants [50% Damage Reduction Barrier 2] to all allies, grants [Attach Holy Stacking], [Attach Holy] and [Saintly Duel Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: 50% Damage Reduction Barrier 2
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 50% for the next two attacks

description.name: Attach Holy Stacking
description.text: Allow to stack Attach Holy, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Attach Holy
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Holy damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Holy resistance +20%

description.name: Saintly Duel Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Saintly Duel after using a Holy ability
